title: Network Delay Time
hints: The signal reaches each node at the length of its shortest path from k. Which algorithm computes single-source shortest paths when all weights are non-negative?
Dijkstra with a min-heap of (distance, node). Pop the smallest; if its distance is larger than the one already recorded for that node, the entry is stale, so skip it.
The answer is the largest finalised distance, or -1 if fewer than n nodes were ever settled. Nodes are 1-indexed; an adjacency list of size n + 1 avoids off-by-ones.
